def: akin to G260 (ἅμα)) as adverb; at the same place or time

occurrences.text: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
